title: The Conscious Spending Plan

source.author: Ramit Sethi
source.work: I Will Teach You to Be Rich

principle: Rather than cutting spending everywhere, decide on purpose which categories deserve generous spending and which don't matter to you. Automate fixed costs, long-term investing and savings into separate transfers, then spend the rest guilt-free because it's already been accounted for.
formula: Net income splits into fixed costs, investments, savings, and guilt-free spending, each a set percentage.
fitsWhen: You want spending on things you love without guilt, as long as fixed costs, investing and savings are handled first and automatically.
critique: It leans on already having stable income and the discipline to automate transfers; it says less about what to do when income is irregular or fixed costs eat most of the paycheck.
